title: KAITO — Mentors We Can Count On〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The day before the solo show
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's really happening...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, it happening tomorrow...
The girls' solo show...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... I figured that Rin would be feeling pretty anxious about this, but not Miku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you think so?
I feel that it's pretty natural.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Especially since they've been watching over MORE MORE JUMP! the longest out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And their very first solo show is really happening tomorrow. I'd sure feel anxious. Wouldn't you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I certainly would♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
Still...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh dear...
I think I'm going to have trouble sleeping again tonight.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm having a hard time understanding how KAITO feels about all this...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe that's just him being him, no♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree... But we sort of do need him to buck up sooner rather than later.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO? If you're stuck in this state, who's going to be there to comfort Miku and Rin?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...!
I need to pull myself together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
E-Everything's going to be okay.
Miku, Rin, let's all just take a deep breath...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think you need to do that the most right now, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You seemed fine when Minori and the others were here. What happened between now and then?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A-Are you kidding? Of course I can't show Minori and the others how I'm really feeling. Not before their big show! What if I made them worry?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you made sure to take their mental state into account even though you were struggling. That's impressive.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, KAITO's been worrying about them ever since they came to him for advice regarding how to set up their venue and figuring out designated routes for the audience...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: H-Hmm... I really hope everything goes well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm a lot more nervous for them than I ever was for my own shows.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... My heart's racing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I understand why you're all worried, but I'm sure that they're going to do just fine. You both know that they worked really hard to get to this point.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They probably will because they work so hard and care about their fans so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly. So, until then, we should try to relax as we wait for their curtains to go up on their big show♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, okay...
Th-Then, let's think of a way for us to have fun tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Miku
rows.Line: Y-Yeah!
After the solo show
Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Th-That was so incredible...!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, I almost started tearing up partway through! They... They all sparkled so much...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It reminded me of just how wonderful idol shows can be. Their performance was really something else...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Minori must've worked so hard for this. She was probably doing everything she could even when we weren't there to watch...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
We sorta ran into some trouble right as we were about to go clean everything up...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Minori was about to go buy some water for us and ended up opening the staff door that leads to the main exit... Right into the view of our fans as they filed out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Airi! They don't need to know that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. More importantly, congratulations on a successful solo show! It was amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
We really appreciate you all taking the time to come by and watch.

rows.Speaker: Staff's Voice
rows.Line:
Staff, please gather!
We're going to start taking everything down now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... I'm sorry, we need to head back...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Don't mind us. We know you girls have an after party later too. So, we'll talk again in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <W-Wait! Before you go...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: P-Present!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You really shined on stage as you sang and danced today. And your speech at the end was so moving.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, I was really moved by that too! Just thinking about it is starting to make me... Oh no...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<My point exactly!
That part about idols being in a position to not just give hope, but also receive was so...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <KAITO, we shouldn't keep them too long.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Especially since we'll have plenty of time to talk to them later. So, let's go.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <W-Wait... Okay, MEIKO, I understand...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Anyway, see you later in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! We absolutely promise to stop by to talk about today!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You kept your cool while you were watching them, KAITO, but it's like a switch flipped inside your head after the show was over...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha...
I think it's because I was so focused on not missing a moment of it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: B-But I got to see such an astounding show! How am I not supposed to feel this way...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, KAITO's right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree too! Oh no...
Just thinking about it is making me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, you.
I know you're happy, but tears don't belong on that adorable face of yours.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, idol shows really are the best.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They give you hope, fill you with energy and all these different emotions... You learn so much just by watching over them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I completely agree♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And after the show's over, you get to talk about how great it was with everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Precisely! We're so lucky to be their fans!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, let's keep discussing what they just achieved! I'm sure all of you have plenty more to talk about, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, you're not wrong. Alright, let's keep talking.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful!
